snippet.title: C64 Game Zulu
snippet.description:
Charming little game. Hold the fire button down to activate the shield near enemies. Collecting a cauldron hides the maze until you collect a gold face thing. Collecting two cauldrons in a row kills you.

Sorry about the terrible play. Not used to playing on a keyboard!

Released 1984 by Firebird. Programmed by John Mitchell.
